The structure of K2Rb2S2Br8 (K2Rb2(SBr4)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies S-centered tetrahedral environments with four Br neighbors, while K and Rb each adopt octahedral coordination with six Br neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between S tetrahedra and K or Rb octahedra, and edge-sharing between K and Rb octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
